plotEn:
No-nonsense bodyguard Hannah Brooks and her team—consisting of Robbie, Taylor, and Doghouse—are assigned to protect popular action film star Jack Stapleton from a stalker during the holiday season. Hannah and Jack immediately clash. As Hannah discreetly escorts Jack to a hospital in Montana to visit his mother, Connie, who has undergone surgery to remove a tumor, his family inadvertently spots him with her. Assuming that Hannah is Jack's girlfriend, Connie invites her to spend Christmas with the family at their ranch in Montana. Hannah reluctantly agrees to pose as Jack's girlfriend to avoid worrying his mother.
One day, Hannah finds Jack with his family at the local rodeo, where his younger brother Hank is riding, even though she had forbidden him from making a public appearance for his safety. When Hannah and Jack are caught by the rodeo's kiss cam, the two are forced to kiss. The announcer reveals Jack's presence, prompting Hannah to escort him out of the venue. As they grow closer, Jack tells Hannah about his brother Drew, who died in a car accident after the two went to a bar to celebrate Jack's first major Hollywood role. Since then, Jack has avoided coming home.
On Christmas Eve, Connie thanks Hannah for bringing her son back to the ranch. That evening, as the family watches a home movie of Jack and Drew from their childhood, Hank accuses Jack of abandoning him and the rest of the family after Drew's death to focus on his film career.
